text: Stepping into this space, I find myself surrounded by an atmosphere of inquiry and potential. The sight of the glass-walled room hints at focused collaboration and the pursuit of knowledge—the ordered stillness is inviting, yet slightly intimidating in its transparency. Moving to the R+D display, vibrant colors and bold text stir a sense of curiosity. Here, the intersection between human ingenuity and technological advancement becomes tangible. I feel a quiet excitement and an urge to engage, to question how I might also connect and coexist with intelligent systems. The environment reminds me that being present in such places is both a privilege and a responsibility—an invitation to think deeply about progress and my role within it.
